name: Conformance & Documentation

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Job to validate TypeDoc configuration and ensure docs can be generated
  validate-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate TypeDoc
        run: npm run check

  # Job to publish API documentation to GitHub Pages
  publish-gh-pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    needs: validate-docs
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: https://modelcontextprotocol.github.io/typescript-sdk/
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Fetch all history for tags

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate and Deploy Documentation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Ensure the script is executable
          chmod +x scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh
          
          # Run the generation script with the release tag
          # The script handles:
          # 1. Parsing the version from the tag
          # 2. Creating/switching to gh-pages branch via worktree
          # 3. Generating TypeDoc for the specific version
          # 4. Updating latest_version.yml
          # 5. Copying Jekyll templates for the latest version
          # 6. Committing and pushing to gh-pages
          ./scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"

name: Conformance & Documentation

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Job to validate TypeDoc configuration and ensure docs can be generated
  validate-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:

        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate TypeDoc
        run: npm run check

  # Job to publish API documentation to GitHub Pages
  publish-gh-pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    needs: validate-docs
    environment:
      name: github-pages

      - name: Setup Node.js

          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

          # Ensure the script is executable

          ./scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
